title: Richard Taylor's instruments and George Washington on bass
summary: Taylor bought many instruments but could not play; George Washington played upright bass in the boys' band as well as trombone.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: April 11th or 10th, 1962. You say Richie Taylor had a lot of instruments?
Yeah, he could buy all of those instruments.
All kinds. Which ones did he try himself?
He tried drums and he tried horns and all that, but he couldn't have them. Music just wasn't in him. It just wasn't in him to play the music, but he loved it.
So what would he do with those horns and drums and things that he had?

Well, we used to practice. Drum with the fudges. They didn't have no instruments. George Washington played bass. He didn't have no upright bass. They weren't using them tubers like they use now. They had them upright basses. You know what a upright bass is. They want you to hold in front of them. Yeah. And so Richie Taylor was named George. I did bass. And they could play a bass too.
I didn't know that George Washington was a bass player. I always thought he was a tramo player.
A bass player. I didn't even tell you about George playing bass. But he could play tramo too.

Well I heard of him mostly with guys like Buddy Petit, you know, on tramo. But he played bass in the brass band and stuff? Yeah, he played bass in the brass band. Did he play steady with any brass band?

Well, not enough, I can't recall. But I know he played some jobs. You know what? Sometimes he could sit in. You see, in those days, them boys, young, after he could play, those old guys would leave him and come up in the band. The band would play. And after he could play good enough to keep up, they would take him in that band if he wanted to come. They'd make it by my way to put on the pedal on. Yeah. That's the play with the band. When I started with the way in the name of God, I was in short band. But after I got in the name of God, I put on long band.
